newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling weakens further against dolllar.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling weakens further against dolllar.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling weakened further against the dollar on continued dollar buying amid very thin supply, commercial bank dealers said on Friday.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a mean shilling rate of 54.90 against the dollar from 54.80 while against the pound, the shilling was posted at a mean of 92.67 from 91.72.
They said for every five dollars sold they were receiving one dollar.
"The thin export sales are weighing down the shilling and making it lose against the dollar," one dealer said
At mid-morning rates were standing at 55.30/55.50.
Meanwhile the money market remained tight. Overnight rates were quoted at 23 percent unchanged.
